study: Stronger continuous minimax common-open and causal comparisons
design: Development-derived six uniform prescribed roots and six fixed targets;36 problems, not new biological replicates.
methods: Continuous causal first action with observation-only second-action reoptimization
objective: Minimize worst absolute terminal log-ratio error over nine independent K×K paths; ties worst log biomass then insertion order; no economic objective switch.

labels.comparison: exact <= threshold; no numerical comparison tolerance added to labels

optimizer.parameterization: [0,1]^2 open / [0,1]^4 causal, stage-two bound accounts for selected first feed
optimizer.preserved: Every evaluated feed candidate and metrics, selected complete states, all solver statuses including failures and budget exhaustion

incumbents.rule: Re-evaluate exact saved open/causal feed values; retain them without encode/decode alteration. No81/161grid initial seeding.
incumbents.causal_embedding: Retain exact best-found open plan in causal class. Shared open optimization is prerequisite cost, not free information.
incumbents.costs: Count41tree construction once per root as shared offline prerequisite; retain per-root seconds/transitions and no division implying online cost.

causality: Reject candidate if exactly identical predicted full states receive different controls. Planned tree objective remains distinct from independently deployed policy.

deployed_second.causal: Observed independently integrated full state only; all selected three second feeds supplied as common seeds to every state.
deployed_second.local_rule: Refine every discrete local minimum bracket with bounded minimize_scalar
deployed_second.selection: Minimum error of all evaluated physical candidates; worstlogB then feed tie break
deployed_second.limit: Best evaluated continuation, not scalar global optimum or uncertain-observation controller

audit.independent_model: Physical amounts DOP853, independent rate/interpolation assembly; shared scientific tables
audit.records: Matched interval and cumulative same-feed chain comparisons distinct. Planned-vs-deployed objectives distinct. Physical/label/numerical failures all retained.

runtime: Single native thread per process;three root workers requested; cumulative per-method CPU-like elapsed sums and total wall separately. Offline construction is not real-time controller latency.
limitations: Best-found continuous candidates, not globally certified optimum
Same finite K uncertainty and two related mathematical families
Only36 prespecified roots-targets; no new experimental validation
